subject: general
question: Smart cities and Academia Towards Action and Research (SAAR) scheme was launched by the ______.

options.text: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

solution:
The correct answer is__** Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs. **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Smart cities and Academia with regards to Action and Research (SAAR) project is a joint initiative of** Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs and some of the leading academic institutions in India. **
 
• The scheme comprises **15 premier planning institutions and 47 smart cities** that will take part in 75 case studies. 
 
• The SAAR initiative will also give **opportunities for engagement on urban development projects to students** and enable an information flow in the middle of urban practitioners and academia. 
 
• 
 
The main motive of this scheme is to **expand the urban knowledge base** and better understand the development plans that will be started. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Ministry of Commerce and Industry administers** two sectors, the Department of Commerce and the Department for advertising of Industry & Internal Trade. 
 
• **The mandate of the Ministry of Culture** consider around the works like preservation and conservation of our cultural heritage and advancement of all forms of art and culture, both tangible and intangible. 
 
• **Ministry of External Affairs** is a part of the Indian administration that is executive for maintaining relations and communication with other countries. ​
